mechanical_ir_invariant: schema-v1 programs are compositions of whole-grid dihedral permutations and global color substitutions. They cannot condition an edit on region membership, repeated-cell position, local neighborhood, or peer-cell agreement. In particular, absent a spatial crop/partition/conditional-write primitive, they cannot change only some occurrences of a color while retaining other occurrences of that same color at unchanged coordinates.

0607ce86.observed_arc_r030_program_family: parseable but non-covering; persisted treatment includes identity candidates
0607ce86.training_evidence: Input/output pairs preserve a repeated large-scale lattice/template while selectively correcting noisy cells. Multiple occurrences of colors are retained while other occurrences are changed, so neither a global recolor nor a whole-grid dihedral transform can represent the demonstrated mapping.
0607ce86.search_or_prompt_secondary: Candidate collapse may also exist, but no search over the current schema can recover the demonstrated conditional local repair mapping.

06df4c85.training_evidence: The task is organized as a separator-defined lattice of repeated cells. Outputs selectively populate previously empty cell interiors while leaving other zero cells and separator lines unchanged. A global recolor would alter all matching zeros; rotations/flips only permute existing cells. The required conditional region-level propagation is therefore outside schema-v1.
06df4c85.search_or_prompt_secondary: Prompt diversity cannot overcome a representation that lacks region-selective read/write semantics.

generic_primitive_family_proposal.name: lattice-region map/reduce
generic_primitive_family_proposal.purpose: Represent transformations over repeated separator- or periodicity-defined cells without task-specific coordinates or colors.
minimal_capabilities: infer a regular cell lattice from repeated separator lines or periodic boundaries
extract cell payloads into a region grid
compute a reusable peer-derived payload by equality/majority over aligned cells
conditionally write a derived payload to selected cells using generic predicates such as empty/nonempty/equality-to-peer
reassemble the original canvas while preserving separators
generic_primitive_family_proposal.anti_overfit_rule: No task IDs, absolute coordinates, fixed task colors, or hand-entered target patterns may appear in the primitive implementation or model prompt.

adversarial_interpretation: The audit proves schema-v1 insufficiency for these observed training mappings, not that a lattice primitive will be sufficient or that induction quality is healthy. A richer IR could remain unused, be mis-induced, or overfit the two diagnostics. Therefore the next experiment must change only expressivity and retain the same two-task matched comparator and model-generation controls.
